name: com.idevice/wearables
title: iDevice
description: Independent buyer's decision engine for phones, wearables and smart glasses: buy, wait or upgrade.

tools.name: should_i_buy
tools.description: For one product: buy_now, wait, skip, check_fit or not_enough_data, optionally for a shopper's owned device, phone platform, budget or use. With the rule, reasons with sources and status, phone fit, timing, price and what it could not answer; for an owner of the model it replaces, the /upgrade answer. display_label is the answer in the words idevice.com prints. For a line slug whose newest model is not on sale, the answer is for the newest that is, named in resolved_to. With buyer_context, buyer_decision and buyer_decision_info carry the personal answer the idevice.com decision page gives for it.

owned_device_slug.description: product_slug of a device the shopper owns

owned_platform.description: The phone platform the shopper uses

budget_usd.description: A price ceiling in US dollars

buyer_context.description: Optional. The shopper's own situation in the buyer-context-v1 grammar, set out at https://idevice.com/mcp/docs#buyer-context. A context outside it is answered with buyer_decision_info naming the fields to fix. It is used for this one answer and goes into no log.

tools.name: check_deal
tools.description: Whether a price offered for one product is a GOOD DEAL, NOT A GOOD DEAL or NOT ENOUGH DATA, against today's lowest price and the lowest recent price of this exact model. For a line slug whose newest model is not on sale, the answer is for the newest that is, named in resolved_to.

price_usd.description: The price offered, in US dollars

retailer.description: Where it was offered, e.g. 'Best Buy'

tools.name: pick_between
tools.description: For two or three products, which one the buy-or-wait rules put ahead, or neither, optionally for a shopper's phone, owned device and budget, each with its verdict, fit, price and reasons; purchase_today and product_for_you split the better purchase from the better product. The same comparison as the decision card on idevice.com. For a line slug whose newest model is not on sale, the answer is for the newest that is, named in resolved_to. With buyer_context, buyer_decision and buyer_decision_info carry the personal answer the idevice.com decision page gives for it.

owned_device_slug.description: product_slug of a device the shopper owns

owned_platform.description: The phone platform the shopper uses

budget_usd.description: A price ceiling in US dollars

buyer_context.description: Optional. The shopper's own situation in the buyer-context-v1 grammar, set out at https://idevice.com/mcp/docs#buyer-context. A context outside it is answered with buyer_decision_info naming the fields to fix. It is used for this one answer and goes into no log.

tools.name: find_best_device
tools.description: A short ranked list of on-sale products in one category, optionally for a phone platform, budget and up to three uses the Guides assign, each with its verdict, phone fit, price, a reason with sources and its Guide's place for the use. In every category iDevice's own pick covers, that pick answers first, then the alternatives it names, each with its verdict, fit, price and sources, and a best_answer block with the reviews behind the pick. The phone and budget decide which products fit, not which is better; priorities are the uses the pick covers.

owned_platform.description: The phone platform the shopper uses

budget_usd.description: A price ceiling in US dollars

tools.name: whats_coming
tools.description: For one product: its stage, the release window and who stated it, and the pre-release reports its Guide lists, each with its status, track record and source.

tools.name: get_product_news
tools.description: Latest iDevice news about one product, each story with the sources it rests on. Newest first; optional limit and since, or a company_key for a company's news.

since.description: Stories on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Every product iDevice covers, with its product_slug, lifecycle and report count; optional query filters by name. is_line marks a line slug, part_of a generation's line. Up to 20 per call.

query.description: Words in the product name, e.g. 'galaxy ring'

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product's lifecycle, price, key dates, availability and where to buy.

tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: One product's price (official, or labelled an estimate), dates, availability and where to buy, a compatibility summary, and specs, each marked Confirmed, Reported, Our read or Not confirmed with its source and date.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Side-by-side specs for 2 or 3 products, each cell with its status, source and date. Optional specs keeps matching rows.

specs.description: Keywords to keep only matching rows

tools.name: get_compatibility
tools.description: Whether a product works with a phone or device: Works, Works with limits (features missing, named), Needs extra hardware, Does not work or Not confirmed (unknown, not incompatible), with source.

query.description: What it should work with, e.g. 'iphone'

tools.name: get_reports
tools.description: Every well-sourced pre-release report for one product, each with its status (Right, Partly right, Wrong, Not checked yet and the rest), outlet count, first reporter and evidence link.

tools.name: search_reports
tools.description: Well-sourced pre-release reports by keyword across every covered product, each with its status and the product's lifecycle. Up to 20 per call.

tools.name: get_in_the_box
tools.description: What ships in the box for one product, per configuration, as the official page states it.

variant.description: Part of a configuration name, e.g. 'Pro'

tools.name: get_release_history
tools.description: Every generation of a product's line with announcement and release dates, sources and launch price, and the gaps between releases.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Outlets' review scores for one product: the Review Consensus (from two or more publishers), the themes reviewers agree on, and each review with its outlet, rating and link.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Dated prices for one product: today's verified price (or null with the reason), the lowest recent price with its basis and period, and the price history.

tools.name: get_detailed_facts
tools.description: Every individual fact for one product by topic, each with value, unit, who stated it and source. Optional topic; paged with offset and limit.

offset.description: Facts to skip, for the next page

limit.description: Facts per page. Default and maximum 20.

tools.name: get_release_calendar
tools.description: Products not yet on sale, in date order, with the date or window and who stated it; default the next 120 days. Up to 20 per call.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default 120 days after from; at most 366 days.

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: On-sale products in one category, cheapest first, optionally under a price, by company or working with a device, each with its price and date, iDevice's verdict and Guide link. Up to 20 per call.

category.description: glasses, rings, watches, earbuds, phones, headsets or fitness trackers

works_with.description: Only products that work with this, e.g. 'iPhone'

tools.name: get_guide_summary
tools.description: One product's Guide summary: bottom line, key facts, price, dates, and what bears on buying now or waiting, with iDevice's verdict.

tools.name: get_report_card
tools.description: One product's pre-release reports rolled up by how they turned out, and the reports, newest first, with reporter, outlet, status and link.

tools.name: get_ownership_facts
tools.description: What owning one product involves, with sources: returns, warranty, any subscription and first-year cost, support status, recalls and update windows.

section.description: returns, warranty, subscription, support or programs

tools.name: get_best_for
tools.description: What one product is best for, from its Guide, with how each use is known; or, with use_case, the products whose Guide ranks that use in its top three.

tools.name: get_variants_and_offers
tools.description: One product's configurations with launch prices, its exact retailer listings, and the conditions on member, coupon, bundle, refurbished or trade-in prices.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: A company as iDevice's directory lists it: name, homepage, description, categories covered and each product with a Guide. Pass a name or key, e.g. 'oura'.

company.description: A company name or key, e.g. 'oura'

tools.name: get_guide_extras
tools.description: A Guide's timeline (events with sources), faq or glossary (one term's definition).

product_slug.description: For timeline and faq: a product_slug

term.description: For glossary: the term, e.g. 'field of view'

tools.name: is_good_price
tools.description: For one product: today's verified price against iDevice's daily record of this exact model (low, median, high over 30 and 90 days) and its published Prices verdict.

tools.name: release_odds
tools.description: For one product not yet released: the expected window, how it is known, who stated it, and the published probability with its sample size where there is one.

tools.name: source_track_record
tools.description: For one reporter or outlet: its pre-release reports graded Right, Partly right or Wrong, the share right, and what it reported first.

name.description: A reporter or outlet, e.g. 'Mark Gurman'

tools.name: whats_moved
tools.description: The week's changes: price moves of 7% or more that held, release windows that changed, and launches, each with its Guide link.
